Open New Hampshire on the map

Key dates

  • Last day to request an absentee ballot in person at your town or city clerk: November 2, 2026. New Hampshire uses absentee ballots for voters who qualify, such as those who will be away or have a disability. Request one from your town or city clerk well before Election Day. The completed ballot must reach the clerk by 5 p.m. on Election Day. New Hampshire has no early voting period.
  • Voter registration (same-day registration available at the polls): November 3, 2026. New Hampshire lets eligible residents register at their polling place on Election Day with proof of identity, age, citizenship and domicile. You can also register earlier with your town or city clerk. Ask your clerk for the last day to register before Election Day.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polling hours are set by each town and city. In Dover, polls are open 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Check your town or city clerk's website for local hours.

Official election information: vote.gov
